title: Learning Platform Domain Model
description: Reusable JSON Schema definitions for user identities, student profiles, instructors, user sessions, enrollments, personalized study plans, and lesson completion records.

StudentProfile.title: Student Profile
StudentProfile.description: Primary domain entity capturing student identity, linked Google Single Sign-On identity, preferences, timezone, and communication settings.

id.description: Stable identifier for the student profile.

identity.description: Identity information associated with the student profile.

googleSsoCredentials.description: Linked Google Single Sign-On identity associated with the student profile.

preferences.description: Preferences associated with the student's learning experience.

timezone.description: IANA timezone identifier associated with the student's profile.

communicationSettings.description: Settings governing communication with the student.

StudentIdentity.title: Student Identity
StudentIdentity.description: Core identity information representing the student.

email.description: Email address representing the student's primary identity.

GoogleSsoCredentials.title: Google SSO Credentials
GoogleSsoCredentials.description: Information linking the student profile to a Google Single Sign-On identity. This represents provider identity metadata rather than an OAuth access or refresh token.

provider.description: Identity provider identifier fixed to Google.

providerSubject.description: Stable subject identifier assigned by Google to the linked identity.

linkedAt.description: Timestamp indicating when the Google identity was linked to the student profile.

StudentPreferences.title: Student Preferences
StudentPreferences.description: Preferences associated with the student's learning experience.

preferredLanguage.description: BCP 47-style language tag representing the student's preferred language.

CommunicationSettings.title: Communication Settings
CommunicationSettings.description: Settings governing communication with the student.

emailNotificationsEnabled.description: Indicates whether email notifications are enabled for the student.

Instructor.title: Instructor / Educator
Instructor.description: Domain entity representing an instructor or educator who manages or delivers specific courses.

id.description: Stable identifier for the instructor or educator.

assignedCourseIds.description: Identifiers referencing courses assigned to the instructor.

UserSession.title: User Session
UserSession.description: Active or historical security session associated with a user.

id.description: Stable identifier for the user session.

userId.description: Identifier referencing the user associated with the session.

authenticationMethod.description: Authentication method used to establish the session.

ipAddress.description: IPv4 address associated with the security session.

deviceFingerprint.description: Device fingerprint associated with the security session, when captured.

startedAt.description: Timestamp indicating when the security session was established.

expiresAt.description: Timestamp indicating when the security session expires, when an expiration time applies.

isActive.description: Indicates whether the security session is currently active.

Enrollment.title: Enrollment
Enrollment.description: Junction entity linking a student to a specific course version and representing the enrollment lifecycle.

studentId.description: Identifier referencing the student associated with the enrollment.

courseVersionId.description: Identifier referencing the specific course version in which the student is enrolled.

status.description: Current lifecycle status of the enrollment.

enrolledAt.description: Timestamp indicating when the enrollment began.

suspendedAt.description: Timestamp at which the enrollment was suspended, when applicable.

completedAt.description: Timestamp at which the enrollment was completed, when applicable.

canceledAt.description: Timestamp at which the enrollment was canceled, when applicable.

personalizedStudyPlan.description: Personalized study plan associated with this enrollment.

PersonalizedStudyPlan.title: Personalized Study Plan
PersonalizedStudyPlan.description: Study plan instance derived from a study plan template and tailored to an individual student's enrollment, start date, target pace, and progress trajectory.

id.description: Stable identifier for the personalized study plan.

templateId.description: Identifier referencing the study plan template from which this personalized plan is derived.

startDate.description: Calendar date on which the personalized study plan begins.

targetPace.description: Target progression rate established for the personalized study plan.

progressTrajectory.description: Current progression information relative to the personalized study plan.

TargetPace.title: Target Pace
TargetPace.description: Relative pacing target describing the expected rate at which the student progresses through the study plan.

value.description: Positive magnitude of the target progression rate.

unit.description: Unit describing the target progression rate.

ProgressTrajectory.title: Progress Trajectory
ProgressTrajectory.description: Progress information describing the student's movement through the personalized study plan.

completedCount.description: Number of study-plan items completed by the student.

totalCount.description: Total number of study-plan items represented by the progression.

estimatedCompletionDate.description: Projected calendar date on which the student is expected to complete the study plan.

aheadOrBehindDays.description: Number of days ahead of or behind the target schedule; positive values indicate ahead and negative values indicate behind.

LessonCompletionRecord.title: Lesson Completion Record
LessonCompletionRecord.description: Record tracking completion state, timestamps, and pass/fail outcome for an individual lesson or quiz for a student enrollment.

id.description: Stable identifier for the lesson completion record.

enrollmentId.description: Identifier referencing the enrollment for which the completion is recorded.

lessonId.description: Identifier referencing the individual lesson or quiz for which completion is recorded.

completionStatus.description: Completion state of the lesson or quiz.

startedAt.description: Timestamp indicating when the student began the lesson or quiz, when recorded.

completedAt.description: Timestamp indicating when the lesson or quiz was completed, when applicable.

passFailStatus.description: Pass or fail outcome recorded when an assessment outcome applies.

score.description: Quantitative assessment score associated with the lesson or quiz, when applicable.

AssessmentScore.title: Assessment Score
AssessmentScore.description: Value object capturing quantitative assessment score information when an assessment produces a measurable result.

maxScore.description: Maximum possible score for the assessment.
